mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, reducing fluoxetine metabolism and increasing serotonergic effects; fluoxetine is also a CYP2D6 inhibitor creating bidirectional inhibition.
action: Monitor for increased fluoxetine adverse effects (serotonin syndrome, CNS effects); consider dose adjustment or alternative TB agent; baseline and periodic assessment recommended.
